title: help with one maths question from a photographed page is answered on the canvas, with tappable choices, never a document or a map of cards
note: Owner: a photo of a child's worksheet and a request for help with one question gave a map of six cards, background work for the others, and the help as text steps in the document view. The answer is on the canvas; the question is shown, a choice of ways is tapped. The recording lives in the data dir; this file holds only neutral words and checks.

turns.say: Can you help me with one question from this homework? She does not know division yet, so a visual step by step guide please, I want her to use the pen
